result.evidence_quote: This 12-week randomized, placebo-controlled trial aimed to improve metabolic health through increasing distal SCFA production while inhibiting proteolytic fermentation using a fiber supplement that increased distal SCFA production in vitro.
result.rationale: The study focuses on dietary fiber, gut fermentation, insulin sensitivity, and metabolic health. It does not investigate brain or neural mechanisms, cognition, neurological injury, or neurological disease treatments or biomarkers.
